# Subway Seat for KDE Plasma

Every color group Plasma reads (window, view, button, header, active and inactive, selection, tooltip, complementary) plus the window-manager title colors. KDE apps, Plasma itself and, through Plasma's GTK settings, GTK apps pick it up. Konsole has its own port. Plasma's automatic light and dark switching changes global themes, not color schemes, so pick a flavor.

[KDE Plasma](https://kde.org/plasma-desktop/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/kde/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme subway-seat-enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme london-moquette
```

**London Deep Level**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme london-deep-level
```

**London Portland**, in System Settings › Colors & Themes › Colors, or a shell:

```sh
plasma-apply-colorscheme london-portland
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/subway-seat.colors`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/subway-seat-tunnel.colors`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/subway-seat-enamel.colors`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/london-moquette.colors`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/london-deep-level.colors`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/color-schemes/london-portland.colors`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
